behaviors.protocol_context: Fixed membership; instance identified by origin replica and instance index, with ballot and value ballot
behaviors.trigger: handlePropose/startPhase1 or received PreAccept and PreAcceptReply
writes: Proposer allocates local row slot, derives conflicts and initial attributes, initializes leader bookkeeping and broadcasts to FastQuorumSize()-1 peers in thrifty mode.
Receiver rejects lower ballot; otherwise advances bal and computes attributes only below ACCEPTED. Existing accepted-or-later records retain attributes.

Replies of lastTriedBallot increment preAcceptOKs; merge attributes except local replica coordinate. Initial ballot, allEqual and (for N>7) committed dependencies permit fast commit; otherwise enough replies trigger Accept.
important_branches: N<=3 and Thrifty bypass reply attribute equality requirement.
For accepted-or-later records missing commands, PreAccept fills the LeaderId row rather than Replica row.
Leader bookkeeping seq starts at -1 and ballot at -1; reply VBallot can replace attributes and status.
existing_protections: Lower ballot PreAccept rejected; stale replies rejected; bookkeeping phase guard.
unknowns: Does quorum sizing and attribute merging preserve required support across permitted N and recovery ownership?

behaviors.protocol_context: Fixed membership; instance identified by origin replica and instance index, with ballot and value ballot
writes: Receiver creates NONE record if absent; for nonstale and not committed records installs Seq, Deps, bal and vbal but does not assign Status or Cmds.
Leader counts replies matching lastTriedBallot while lb.status is ACCEPTED; acceptOKs+1>N/2 sets local COMMITTED and broadcasts Commit.
external_effects: Receiver replies with current bal after all branches; leader may reply to clients if Dreply is false.
existing_protections: Stale Accept cannot replace attributes; committed/executed record protected.
unknowns: What recovery guarantee is established by an acknowledgement whose stored Status remains preaccepted or NONE?
Higher-ballot AcceptReply retry block follows a != ballot return and appears unreachable.

writes: BeTheLeader sets IsLeader true; no revocation in this handler.

Recovery preserves client proposals but replaces bookkeeping, copies current value information, chooses lastTriedBallot, and changes both local bal and vbal to that ballot before adding self PrepareReply.
Prepare raises bal on a higher ballot while retaining vbal, Cmds, Seq, Deps and Status for its reply.
external_effects: Recovery sends Prepare to alive peers; Prepare replies report current stored record.

cross_activity_effects.A1: The ballot promise rejects older formation requests; the separate value ballot and status feed recovery selection.

writes: Creates missing record; rejects if already committed/executed or if commit ballot is below bal. Otherwise installs command/attributes and COMMITTED, updates conflicts and committed prefix.
external_effects: A NOOP commit for own row can requeue client proposals; persistence calls here do not sync.

behaviors.protocol_context: Fixed membership; instance identified by origin replica and instance index, with ballot and value ballot
behaviors.trigger: Execution goroutine scans rows; executes committed dependency graph
writes: Only committed records with commands enter SCC execution; dependencies must be present with commands and committed or executed. SCCs sort by Seq, origin replica, then local proposeTime. Commands mutate state and records become EXECUTED.
external_effects: With Dreply and local proposals, execute and return result using proposal CommandId/Timestamp; otherwise execute PUT only.
async_boundaries: Incomplete row prefix accrues loop-based grace time and queues instance recovery; protocol run goroutine consumes that queue.

cross_activity_effects.A7: Default Dreply returns results after command execution.

unknowns: Tie-breaking by local proposeTime for same-row equal-Seq SCC members requires checking reachability.

behaviors.protocol_context: Fixed registered peer address list and configured failure budget
writes: Launcher computes F=(configured replica count-1)/2; EPaxos forces thriftiness and disables durability in launcher. Master returns stable index and full nodeList after N registrations.
Peer connections establish Alive flags; listener clears Alive on read failure. Dispatch unmarshals independent message objects and queues each via a delay goroutine.

cross_activity_effects.A1: Fast quorum is F+(F+1)/2; slow recovery quorum is (N+1)/2; live preferred peers determine destinations.
cross_activity_effects.A2: Master calls BeTheLeader after selected leader failure; per-instance ballot handling supplies request qualification.

unknowns: Even-membership admissibility and intended fast-quorum sizing are not explicitly documented in read sources.

facts.meaning: The local instance record carries current promised ballot bal, value ballot vbal, phase Status, commands and ordering attributes used in protocol replies and recovery selection; fields are not asserted to advance atomically or to certify acceptance.
facts.validity_context: In-memory record at one replica in fixed membership; bal and vbal may differ after Prepare and status may remain unchanged after Accept.
facts.durability: In-memory in launcher configuration; guarded persistence does not establish restart reconstruction.
facts.recovery: Prepare reports the record; recovery selection uses value ballot and status before Accept or restarted phase1.
unknowns: Which acknowledged value information remains recoverable after an acceptor retains preaccepted status?

facts.meaning: A local instance is marked COMMITTED with its command and ordering attributes; execution additionally requires commands and ready dependency records.
facts.validity_context: Fast/slow leader decision, received Commit, or recovery installation of committed history; local status can later become EXECUTED.
facts.recovery: Recovery can install selected committed/executed record; Commit can be rejected below local promised ballot.

formation.explanation: A client proposal allocates its origin row slot and establishes command/Seq/Deps at its owner. PreAccept receivers qualify ballot and merge local conflicts, reporting current value ballot and status. Matching replies supply the fast threshold; initial ballot plus equality and large-N committed-dependency conditions permit direct commit, otherwise Accept is broadcast and matching majority replies commit. Commit propagates the full tuple. Execution waits for committed dependency graph and orders SCCs before application and default client response.

context.explanation: Authority is per instance, not solely the master-selected leader. Initial ballot equals origin replica; recovery replaces leader bookkeeping and chooses a ballot based on proposer id and, when IsLeader, maxRecvBallot. Prepare raises the local promise and returns prior value ballot/status; formation rejects older requests and reply handlers qualify lastTriedBallot/phase. Execution detects incomplete work and queues recovery. Prepare quorum selection adopts highest value-ballot record and chooses committed installation, Accept, or restarted phase1; old client proposals are retained. Already committed records resist subsequent Accept and Commit replacement.

connection.explanation: Formation writes the same tuple and status that Prepare exposes to new owners. bal qualifies old requests while vbal and Status determine how old support is interpreted during recovery. Acks can contribute to local commit even though the receiver Accept path does not change Status; this discrepancy is retained rather than assuming an acceptance guarantee. Commit and execution establish prior decisions that restrict later handlers. Per-message delay goroutines mean pending messages can overlap authority changes; no FIFO handler-delivery assumption is used.
